prompt: A NullPointerException is thrown on the contains() call. Why?
choices: contains() does not accept String arguments
input is null — calling any method on null throws NullPointerException
null cannot be compared with Strings
contains() requires the argument to be non-null
explanation: Calling any method on a null reference throws NullPointerException. Guard: if (input != null && input.contains("hello")) { ... } Or use Objects.toString(input, "").contains("hello") for a null-safe version.
